data.description:
Monky Things is a Gorilla Tag fan game where players explore maps, some normal, some filled with supernatural elements and hidden secrets. As players navigate, they must use their agility to explore and escape from mysterious creatures. With dynamic gameplay, each map offers a thrilling, unpredictable experience.

Maps:
Exploration & Hidden Secrets: Each map is filled with surprises and hidden areas waiting to be discovered. Explore detailed environments, uncover secrets, and solve environmental puzzles to unlock special abilities or access restricted zones.

Supernatural Encounters: Not all maps are as they seem. Players may encounter strange, supernatural creatures lurking in the shadows. These entities vary in behavior, from lurking in the background to actively chasing and confronting players. Use your skills and quick reflexes to escape or outmaneuver these mysterious threats.

Multiplayer: Engage in thrilling lobbies with friends or other players, each with its own set of challenges. The unpredictable nature of the game ensures no two sessions are the same. Work together to solve puzzles, explore hidden areas, or compete in timed challenges to see who can survive the longest.

Chilling Atmosphere: The game combines elements of horror and mystery, using ambient sound design and visual effects to create an immersive experience. Players can expect jumpscares, unsettling audio cues, and eerie visuals that enhance the suspense and thrill of the game.
